name: EPIC 220180312
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 9.9 solar radii and 0.86 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220180312 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM radius (solar radii) 9.894934 (16th-84th percentiles 9.668973-10.237793), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 2,634 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.86 solar masses and 9.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,885 K at its surface.
